page.overview:
Who is 88?

88 was a member and icon for the National Force. The group believed that when they enforced a New World Order, people would only be allowed to reproduce with 88. He was eventually killed by Jack Monroe after Jack overrode control of his cybernetic gun and forced 88 to kill his fellow Neo-Nazis.
